holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank appointed Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO for three years starting October 27, 2026.
September 2026 gross advances reached ₹33,075 billion and deposits reached ₹33,275 billion.
Sudhir Kumar Jha superannuated on September 30, 2026, and Jigar Shah took over as General Counsel.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter was ₹20,383 crore on revenue of ₹90,575 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's largest position at 9.11% weight. Its -13.82% three-month return detracted -1.259% from fund returns, driving the overall weakness across the fund's 32.8% Financials sector.

watch.text: Transition to incoming MD and CEO Anup Bagchi on October 27, 2026.
Release of Q2 financial results amid reported institutional selling pressure.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter was ₹16,276 crore on revenue of ₹52,241 crore.
ICICI Bank scheduled earnings media and analyst calls for October 17, 2026 to present Q2 FY2027 numbers.

holdings.why_it_matters: At an 8.43% weight, ICICI Bank is the fund's second-largest asset. Its -4.93% three-month return generated an estimated -0.416% contribution drag, compounding sector losses.

watch.text: Q2 FY2027 results and management commentary on October 17, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: The stock hit an 18-month low after declining 28% from its January high.
The Supreme Court directed MMRDA to deposit ₹646 crore in the BKC case.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance carries a 5.66% portfolio weight. Its -10.64% three-month return delivered an estimated -0.602% negative contribution, making it the fund's second-biggest performance drag.

watch.text: Developments and shareholding data around the proposed Jio Platforms IPO.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit margin rose to 41% on sales of ₹3,080 crore and net profit of ₹902 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
Shareholders approved all AGM resolutions, including a ₹30 dividend per share.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 5.43% fund weight, Divi's was the fund's strongest individual performer over three months, surging 35.85% and adding +1.947% to portfolio return.

watch.text: Potential inclusion in the NSE index review for March 2027.
Peptide CDMO demand and commercial opportunities following global manufacturer shifts.

holdings.name: Grasim Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached ₹3,846 crore on sales of ₹48,716 crore.
The company repaid ₹750 crore of commercial paper on September 24, 2026, leaving zero commercial paper debt outstanding.
Aditya Birla Renewables allotted 23.15 crore equity shares to Grasim Industries.
SEBI cleared Grasim's open offer.

holdings.why_it_matters: Grasim accounts for 4.13% of the portfolio. Its -9.11% three-month drop detracted -0.376% from fund returns within the 13.5% Materials basket.

watch.text: Progress and investor uptake on the open offer following SEBI clearance.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹10,012 crore on sales of ₹58,539 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
Airtel rolled out refreshed postpaid plans featuring free annual international roaming.
Airtel Business introduced IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications platform compliant with DPDP rules.
The Department of Telecommunications levied penalties totaling over ₹12 lakh across September and October 2026 for subscriber verification issues.

holdings.why_it_matters: Airtel holds a 3.98% weight in the portfolio. A -6.47% three-month decline trimmed overall returns in the fund's 10.1% Technology allocation.

watch.text: ARPU uplift following the October postpaid tariff overhaul.
Competitive and valuation impacts from the planned Jio IPO.

holdings.name: LG Electronics India Ltd.

what_changed.text: The company introduced 15 semi-automatic washing machine models, planning exports to over 10 countries starting in 2027.
Customs issued a show cause notice proposing a ₹153.57 crore duty recovery on royalty inclusion.
LG launched its Diwali festive offers valid through November 15, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.78% fund weight, LG Electronics returned 11.89% over three months and contributed +0.449%, making it the fund's second-highest positive contributor.

watch.text: Outcome of the ₹153.57 crore customs duty show cause notice.
Potential large-cap status classification in the AMFI semi-annual categorization review.

holdings.name: DLF Ltd

what_changed.text: DLF sold out its luxury residential project The Aureva, generating approximately ₹1,985 crore in sales.
June 2026 net profit stood at ₹794 crore on sales of ₹1,280 crore.
Madhukar Housing applied for reclassification from promoter group to public shareholder.

holdings.why_it_matters: DLF represents 3.68% of the fund and is its sole Real Estate holding. Its -4.74% three-month decline created a mild drag on overall performance.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 16, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year financial results.
Local resident opposition to DG set installations near Moulsari Avenue in Gurugram.

holdings.name: Tata Steel Ltd

what_changed.text: Second-quarter India crude steel production rose 10% YoY to 6.21 million tonnes, with deliveries of 5.97 million tonnes.
Tata Steel acquired TSHP shares worth USD 340 million (₹3,260.32 crore) on September 29, 2026.
NCLT Mumbai approved the amalgamation of wholly owned unit Rujuvalika Investments.
ITAT granted a deduction claim for FY2009, lowering tax exposure by ₹427 crore to ₹1,259 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Tata Steel constitutes 3.63% of the portfolio. Its -7.95% three-month loss added to the broader Materials sector pullback alongside Grasim.

watch.text: Market impact of the draft steel policy 2047.

holdings.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: SBI Life received a GST demand notice of ₹1.13 crore for April-August 2025 and plans to appeal.
Nihar Niranjan Jambusaria was appointed as Additional Independent Director on September 22, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: SBI Life represents 3.46% of the fund. Its -9.43% three-month loss worsened the negative performance from the fund's heavy 32.8% Financials position.

watch.text: IRDAI distribution rules and potential revisions to commission caps.
Outcome of the legal appeal against the ₹1.13 crore GST demand.

portfolio.statement: Bajaj Finserv Large Cap Fund declined 5.18% over the past 3 months, as substantial declines across top financial and materials holdings outweighed sharp gains in healthcare.
interp: Top detractors HDFC Bank, Reliance Industries, Grasim, and Tata Steel exerted pressure on overall fund returns.
Gains were concentrated in Divi's Laboratories (+35.85%) and LG Electronics India (+11.89%), providing partial offset.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking and materials drags overshadowed strong single-stock healthcare performance.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 13.82% over three months, generating the portfolio's deepest individual drag (-1.259%) ahead of its Q2 results and CEO handover.
Divi's Laboratories jumped 35.85% over three months, delivering an estimated +1.947% positive contribution as its June 2026 operating margin hit 41%.
Reliance Industries dropped 10.64% over three months to hit an 18-month low, detracting -0.602% from fund performance.

themes.title: Private Financials Pressure
themes.text: With 32.8% in Financials, broad weakness across HDFC Bank (-13.82%), ICICI Bank (-4.93%), and SBI Life (-9.43%) created the primary drag on portfolio value.

themes.title: Materials Consolidation
themes.text: Materials represent 13.5% of the fund, where Grasim Industries and Tata Steel each corrected over 7% to 9% during the quarter.

themes.title: Consumer Discretionary Support
themes.text: Consumer Discretionary accounts for 16.6% of the portfolio, supported by positive price momentum in LG Electronics India.

macro.why: Deposit and advance trajectories dictate performance across the fund's largest exposures, where HDFC Bank registered ₹33,075 billion in advances and ₹33,275 billion in deposits.
Regulatory caps on commissions by IRDAI directly affect distribution economics and product margins for private insurers.
Domestic volume trends and the draft steel policy 2047 influence output levels and steel pricing across Indian mills.

priced_in.text: HDFC Bank's scheduled MD and CEO transition to Anup Bagchi effective October 27, 2026.
Grasim Industries completely retiring its commercial paper liabilities.

could_change.title: Jio Platforms Listing Dynamics
could_change.text: Final valuation metrics and timeline for the Jio Platforms IPO could alter market sentiment for Reliance Industries and telecom peer Bharti Airtel.

could_change.title: Final IRDAI Commission Guidelines
could_change.text: Finalization of distribution caps could shift cost dynamics and margin profiles for SBI Life Insurance.

portfolio.risk_note: The portfolio has a high concentration of capital, with 51.3% of assets held in its top 10 stocks and 32.8% concentrated in Financials, leaving overall performance closely tied to banking sector trends.
